_comment: Recorded baseline of /api/admin/* routes with NO authentication middleware. Shrink this list as each route is repaired; never grow it. check-auth-coverage.php fails on anything not listed here, so a route removed from this list can never regress back to unprotected without the build going red.
_warning: Every entry here is an endpoint reachable with no credentials.
_verified_by: Agent 5, Phase 1B, real PHPUnit 11.5.57 run against baseline b4917c5b. Anonymous GET of categorylist/couponlist/taxlist/shippinglist/variantlist with store_id returned HTTP 200 {"status":1,"message":"successfull"}. Anonymous POST to orders/notes/create returned 200 and took order_notes from 0 rows to 1 with note_type=to_customer -- a confirmed unauthenticated write.

legitimately_public./api/admin/adminlogin: login endpoint -- must be reachable unauthenticated. Carries throttle:auth.
legitimately_public./api/admin/delivery-login: login endpoint -- must be reachable unauthenticated. Carries throttle:auth.
legitimately_public./api/admin/base_url: returns the image base URL; public by design

b4917c5b_phase_1a.note: 13 /api/admin/* routes with no auth middleware; 10 of them had to be protected.

bd6900bc_phase_1b_integration.note: 9 routes gained custom.auth. Measured with this same script on bd6900bc: `php tests/Support/ApiContract/bin/check-auth-coverage.php --json` reported 4 unprotected and 9 now_fixed.

p1c_agent2_api_authz.note: adminlogout gained ['custom.auth','AdminApiLog'] at routes/api.php. It was LOW severity rather than open -- Api/DashboardController::logouto re-implements the hash_equals token check itself, which is why the Phase 1A anonymous probe returned 401 and not 200 -- but the control now lives where every sibling declares it instead of depending on one handler. Measured: this script reports 3 unprotected, all three in legitimately_public. must_be_protected is now EMPTY: there is no /api/admin/* route left that lacks authentication and ought to have it.

_how_to_shrink_this_file: Protect the route first, then remove it from `routes` and record it under `_history`. Do NOT run --update-baseline to shrink it: that writer emits only _comment/_source/_warning/count/routes and would silently delete every piece of evidence in this file, including the empirical probe results that justify the finding. Pinned by tests/Feature/Security/AdminApiSurfaceTest.php.
